posts.title: Lambert follows dream to Atlantic
posts.description: Suzanne Stewart Staff Writer In 1896, two Norwegian-born fishermen and mariners – George Harbo and Frank Samuelsen – were the first to cross the Atlantic Ocean in a rowboat. It took them 55 days and 13 hours to row from New York to Europe in an 18-foot open, wooden boat named The Fox. In 2027,… Read the full story
